transcript.content: Hello. I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because I'm having an issue with my eating. It usually happens at night after everyone goes to bed. I'll tell myself I'm just going to have a few leftovers, but then... I realize I've eaten half a tray of catered pasta from work, the dessert from a client dinner, and whatever snacks were in the pantry, all in one sitting. It's just getting out of hand, so I figured I needed to talk to someone about it.
After these episodes of eating, do you engage in any behaviors to try to compensate for the calories consumed, such as vomiting, using laxatives, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do anything like that. I don't throw up or take anything... and I definitely don't exercise like that. Honestly, after it happens, I just feel really full and terrible about myself, and I usually just go to bed.
